preferences.title: Server address
preferences.summary: Address of your Suwayomi server, for example http://192.168.1.10:4567

preferences.title: Username
preferences.summary: Only needed when the server has basic authentication or UI login turned on

preferences.title: Source
preferences.summary: Installed Suwayomi source for the Popular and Latest tabs and for searching, for example MangaDex (EN). Leave empty to see the installed sources

preferences.title: Search in
preferences.summary: Where the search box looks for titles

options.label: The source when one is set, else the library

preferences.title: Library categories
preferences.summary: Comma-separated category names the Library tab shows. Leave empty for the whole library

preferences.title: Refresh chapters on open
preferences.summary: Ask the source for new chapters every time a title opens. Otherwise the server's stored chapter list is used once it has one
